generalAbilities.name: Electrocommunication
generalAbilities.description: Diaspora worms communicate by shaping and reading electromagnetic fields. This functions like telepathy with creatures that share this ability.

generalAbilities.name: Electromagnetic Sight
generalAbilities.description: Diaspora worms sense their surroundings by reading electromagnetic fields, including disruptions caused by creatures or objects. This is a precise sense within the listed range. Intense fields, such as areas emitting radiation or auras of electricity, make creatures within them Concealed to the diaspora worm.

defensiveAbilities.name: Electromagnetic Blindness
defensiveAbilities.description:
Diaspora worms that take electricity damage must attempt a DC 23 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The worm is unaffected.

Success The worm is Dazzled for 1 round.

Failure The worm is Blinded for 1 round.

Critical Failure The worm is blinded for 1 round, then dazzled for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Darkwater Veil
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The diaspora worm is in water

Effect The worm alters the structure of water within a 10ft Type:emanation, forming light-absorbing nanotubes. This field moves with the worm and lasts for 1 minute. The emanation deactivates non-magical light sources and automatically attempts to counteract magical light (counteract rank 4, counteract modifier +17). This field also provides cover for creatures inside of it from those outside, and vice versa.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swallow Whole
offensiveAbilities.description:
Medium, (1d10+8) Bludgeoning Damage, Rupture 12

See rules...

The monster attempts to swallow a creature of the listed size or smaller that it has grabbed or restrained in its jaws or mouth. If a swallowed creature is of the maximum size listed, the monster can't use Swallow Whole again. If the creature is smaller than the maximum, the monster can usually swallow more creatures; the GM determines the maximum. The monster attempts an athletics|defense:reflex check opposed by the grabbed creature's Reflex DC. If it succeeds, it swallows the creature. The monster's mouth or jaws no longer grab a creature it has swallowed, so the monster is free to use them to Strike or Grab once again. The monster can't attack creatures it has swallowed.

A swallowed creature is Grabbed, is Slowed 1, and has to hold its breath or start suffocating. The swallowed creature takes the listed amount of damage when first swallowed and at the end of each of its turns while it's swallowed. If the victim Escapes this ability's grabbed condition, it exits through the monster's mouth. This frees any other creature grabbed in the monster's mouth or jaws. A swallowed creature can attack the monster that has swallowed it, but only with unarmed attacks or with weapons of light Bulk or less. The swallowing creature is Off-Guard against the attack. If the monster takes piercing or slashing damage equaling or exceeding the listed Rupture value from a single attack or spell, the swallowed creature cuts itself free. A creature that gets free by either Escaping or cutting itself free can immediately breathe and exits the swallowing monster's space.

Effect: Engulf and Swallow Whole

If the monster dies, a swallowed creature can be freed by creatures adjacent to the corpse if they spend a combined total of 3 actions cutting the monster open with a weapon or unarmed attack that deals piercing or slashing damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tongue Grab
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature hit by the diaspora worm's tongue becomes Grabbed. A creature can sever the tongue with a Strike against AC 19 that deals at least 12 Slashing Damage damage. This prevents the worm from using its tongue Strike until it regrows its tongue, which takes 1 day.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tongue Reel
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The diaspora worm has Grabbed a creature with its tongue

Effect The diaspora worm attempts to Reposition the grabbed creature toward the worm. If the grabbed creature is brought to within 10 feet or less of the worm, the worm can attempt to Swallow Whole the creature.
